newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dynamic to sell shares to central bank.
newsitem.headline: Dynamic to sell shares to central bank.

text.p: Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand (1991) Plc said on Monday it will seek to raise capital by 500 million baht to 2.28 billion baht from 1.78 billion by selling 50 million new shares to the central bank's Fund for Rehabilitation and Development of Financial Institutions.

Dynamic Eastern said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that the plan is part of its compliance with a central bank instruction last week for the company to hike capital in 60 days to assure creditors that it could operate soundly.

The finance and brokerage firm was one of 10 companies named by the central bank for facing short-term liquidity problems. The Bank of Thailand said the 10 firms need to raise capital by a combined 8.25 billion baht ($319.8 million).

Dynamic Eastern said it also plans to float another 50 million, 10-baht par shares within three years to further raise capital to 2.78 billion baht. It said details of the second batch of planned new shares would be worked out later.
The Bank of Thailand said last week its participation in raising capital of the 10 firms would be accompanied by its involvement in their future management.
